name: Chuushaki 2
source:
Main character gets hospitalized with abdominal pain of unknown cause. He feels much better after a while and starts hitting after cute nurses when he meets his former girlfriend there. There's the need to set priorities here!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因不明原因的腹痛住进医院。过了一段时间，他的身体明显好转，开始追求可爱的护士，却又在医院里遇见前女友。看来，他需要好好分清事情的轻重缓急！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
